description: A hulking, hairy humanoid stands facing the viewer, framed from the head to the thighs. It has a broad face covered in shaggy brown fur, large pointed ears tipped with red, bright green eyes and a snarl of small teeth. It wears a coat of grey metal scale or chain armor over its chest and belly, with rough brown fur showing at the arms and legs. In its raised left hand (to the viewer's right) it holds a spiked iron mace above its head; in its other hand it grips a heavy, broad curved scimitar with a pale steel blade. The background is a flat, bright cyan. The light is even and the mood is brutish and ready to fight. Frame 1: the scimitar is held angled up across the body, held long. Frame 2: the blade sweeps level across the waist, a flash. Frame 3: the blade swings down to point low to the viewer's right, held a moment. The loop reads as a menacing, repeated slash of the blade while the mace stays raised overhead.
title: Hairy brute swinging scimitar
